fields.title: Load introduction and wind
fields.finding: Uniform pressure envelope and a P2-sized pad mass do not establish P3 attachment strength or nonuniform wind loading.
fields.proposed_fix: Resolve full wind, gust, mooring, payload, cable and landing load paths on the discrete frame.
